description: Structure of the theyos <-> consumer-repo source boundary. This file holds
STRUCTURE ONLY (which files carry cross-repo surface, which files in the
consumer hold a pin, how each pin is spelled). POLICY (how stale a pin may
be, and why that number) lives in scripts/check-cross-repo-pin-freshness.py
so it is reviewed as code.
surface_files is NOT trusted as a complete list. The gate re-derives the
set by sweeping the tree for uniffi markers and fails when the two sets
disagree in either direction. A new uniffi surface crate landing without an
entry here is the exact failure this boundary exists to stop.

pins.name: ffi-cargo-rev
pins.note: The git rev the consumer actually compiles against. This is the pin the FFI surface check is measured on.

pins.name: contract-fixture-sha
pins.note: Rev the vendored owner-approval contract fixtures were copied from. Governs DATA, not the compiled surface.

pins.name: owner-site-a2-r1-corpus
pins.note: Rev the A2-R1 semantic corpus was copied from. Governs DATA, not the compiled surface.
